messages:
andrew: thinking about adding an automatic 'cost throttle' guard to canaries — checks token-cost rate per-tenant + P95 latency and either pauses or soft-degrades. want quick feedback on API & console UX.
rachel: +1 on cost guard. main worry is noisy pauses for small tenants. need min-traffic and trend window. also debounce alerts.
mike: we already have latency SLO checks for rollouts. do we want an AND (cost AND latency) or OR (either) to trigger pause?
sam: prefer AND as default (cost spike alone => billing alert, but don't break traffic). allow policy override per-org.
julia: console-wise, important to show "why" it paused: metric, threshold, window, and sample of offending requests. quick actions: resume, continue rollout (force), or route to fallback model.
ui-team: we can design a compact badge + tooltip for the rollout list row. also an expanded panel with timeline and the last 6 metric buckets. question: should guards be editable from the rollout modal?
andrew: proposing API shape (draft):
```json
{
  "type": "cost_latency_guard",
  "cost_threshold_usd_per_min": 0.50,
  "token_rate_threshold": 20000,
  "latency_p95_ms": 500,
  "window_secs": 300,
  "min_requests": 100,
  "debounce_secs": 120,
  "action": "pause", /* options: pause, fallback, throttle */
  "fallback_model": "gpt-small-quant",
  "notify": ["oncall#infra","tenant-owner"]
}
```
rachel: looks good. add "min_tenant_spend_usd" to avoid tiny tenants triggering.
mike: for fallback action, I'd prefer weighted diversion: e.g. 80% fallback, 20% keep canary for monitoring. maybe action can accept object with weights.
sam: agree. also add "allow_override": true/false for enterprise tenants.
julia: privacy concern: don't show full prompts in the trace by default. sample and mask PII. add a checkbox for tenant-consent to include unmasked examples in the incident packet.
andrew: yep will add sampling + masking defaults.
ops-bot: GUARD_DETECTED: canary_id=canary-245 triggered cost_latency_guard at 2045012390. action=paused. metrics: cost_usd_per_min=0.83, p95=612ms, window=300s.
rachel: need routing for alerts: tenant owner + infra oncall. ops-bot should include link to rollout and an "ack" button.
mike: another idea: instead of pausing, automatically downgrade to a cheap model and keep 1% on canary for health check. less user-visible disruption.
andrew: we can support composite action: {"pause": false, "fallback": {"model": "gpt-small-quant", "weight": 0.99}}. will update spec.
ui-team: I'll sketch the UX: badge, timeline, reason tag, and two-step resume flow (confirm + require note). will post mockups tomorrow.
julia: also request telemetry: record guard decisions, metric snapshots, and postmortem link id. that helps ML teams debug regressions.
andrew: noted. I'll open the spec PR with the API, console mocks, and tests for debounce/edge-cases.
deploy-bot: rollout/update canary-245 config applied by andrew at 2045012402.
ops-bot: NOTIFICATION_SENT: channels=[oncall-infra,tenant-xyz-owner]
andrew: :thumbsup: will follow up with PR and RFC. thanks for quick takes everyone.
